title: Analyze Sketchpad Elements Layout
description: Study component implementations in elements.tsx to understand layout structures, data-slot attributes, and interaction patterns for Label, TreeItem, TreeSection, TreeContent, Stepper, Slider, Input, Textarea, Combobox, and SidePanel components.
summary: Completed detailed layout analysis of 10 components in elements.tsx: Label, TreeContent, TreeSection, TreeItem, Input, Combobox, Slider, Stepper, Textarea, SidePanel. Documented all data-slots, layout structures, sizing defaults, showLabel wrapping patterns, and right-panel sizing interactions.
